== Summary ==
Original slip, 12 October 2004: Unexpected Interruption (V), as printed on the Players Committee's 12 October 2004 sheet for [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire]].

'''Old pre-template slip''' (before the Committee's December 2006 Remaster template).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205104319/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/Virtual%20Set%207.pdf Virtual Set #7 updated sheet] (Players Committee, “Updated 10/12/04”; Virtual Set 7.pdf on swccgpc.com, Internet Archive capture 5 December 2004), page 2, slip 21. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip (with its printed label above it) cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Unexpected Interruption (V) (Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire) (Original)|Unexpected Interruption (V) (Virtual Set 7) (Original)]].
